name: kashflow
description: Read and optionally write IRIS KashFlow accounting data (customers, suppliers, invoices, receipts, journals, nominals, and bank) through the SOAP API, plus optional REST bulk purchase payments.

KASHFLOW_USERNAME.title: KashFlow SOAP API username
KASHFLOW_USERNAME.description: SOAP API UserName from the KashFlow account.

KASHFLOW_PASSWORD.title: KashFlow SOAP API password
KASHFLOW_PASSWORD.description: SOAP API Password. Stored as a secret by Cursor and never logged by the server.

KASHFLOW_MEMORABLE_WORD.title: KashFlow REST memorable word (secret)
KASHFLOW_MEMORABLE_WORD.description: Optional. Account memorable word for REST KfToken session auth. Enables pay_purchases_bulk (batch pay many receipts as one bank line). Stored as a secret by Cursor and never logged. Leave empty to keep SOAP-only tools.

KASHFLOW_READ_ONLY.title: Read only
KASHFLOW_READ_ONLY.description: When true, only read tools are registered and write SOAP/REST calls are blocked (except dryRun). Set false to enable insert_customer, insert_supplier, insert_invoice, insert_receipt2, insert_journal, pay_purchases_bulk, and other writes.
